name: kiki-media
description: Generate images, videos and speech with built-in services and your own scripts in one media plugin.

tools.name: generate
tools.description: Generate an image/edit, video, or speech file through one installed provider. Return original file_id artifacts, or a background Task that notifies on completion. Reuse request_id for the same request; unknown submission must not be automatically resubmitted. Discover models/voices with media rather than guessing. Resume only polls/downloads, never buys a new generation.

tools.name: media
tools.description: Discover installed media provider capabilities/models or voices on demand; inspect, stop or resume one media job. Cancel reports local reception separately from confirmed remote cancellation and does not promise a refund. Resume never submits a new generation.

openai__connectionId.title: Kiki connection (optional)
openai__connectionId.description: Use a media-capable API connection. Selected endpoint and authentication replace this plugin's key; OAuth login alone does not imply image or speech entitlement.

zh.title: Kiki 连接（可选）
zh.description: 使用支持媒体的 API 连接。所选端点与认证会替代本插件的密钥；仅登录 OAuth 并不代表拥有图像或语音权限。

google__connectionId.title: Kiki Google connection (optional)
google__connectionId.description: Use a Gemini API endpoint with x-goog-api-key authentication. Other OAuth products are not assumed compatible.

ark__connectionId.title: Kiki Ark connection (optional)
